correctness.rationale: Direct diagonal decomposition gives two geometric blocks for each full-cycle horizon; endpoint extrema follow strictly, determinant monotonicity uses strictly concave positive logcosh(cx)/x, inverse-trace monotonicity uses strict convexity of 1/(1+exp(yx)), and each step has correct positive domains. Reconstructed algebra and verified 2210 exact rational cases from the embedded checker; exhaustive finite tests are not general proof.

value.rationale: A complete natural placement classification simultaneously solves E-, D-, A- and spectral conditioning objectives with exact values in a sparse directed network. The design is robust to damping and every full-cycle horizon and reveals invariant trace as noninformative. This adds an exact benchmark and distinguishes directed-shift placement from other common ring dynamics, beyond simple textbook substitution.
